name: Ingoku no Houkago
source:
Kudou Souji, originally known as a delinquent, is falsely accused of stealing underwear at school and is suspended.
Soon after, Souji becomes the target of slander and scorn from the entire school body, and his girlfriend, Yoshimiya Mafuyu, chooses to break up with him.

With a burning desire for retribution against the person who wronged him, Souji uses Minamino Kirie, a class teacher who is also his sex slave, to snoop out the culprit.
In truth, Souji is a sexual deviant who has built himself a room in the basement of the storehouse where he lives to discipline sex workers, and he enjoys giving Kirie lewd and lascivious bouts of discipline there.
Through Kirie's investigation, he discovers that the mastermind behind the incident was his former lover -- Mafuyu. After successfully taking her to the basement of his home to exact his revenge, Souji vows to do the same to the female students who have become his foes as a result of this incident.

Souji's means of retaliation is domination through pleasure -- and in order to achieve this, he is determined to turn his prey into prisoners of debauchery.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1201256]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
工藤总司原本被称为不良少年，却被诬陷在学校偷窃内衣而被停学。
不久之后，总司成为全校诽谤和蔑视的对象，而他的女友吉宫真冬也选择与他分手。

总司怀着对冤屈他的人进行报复的强烈愿望，利用兼任他性奴隶的班主任南野桐江来窥探罪魁祸首。
事实上，总司是一个性变态者，他在自己居住的仓库的地下室里为自己建造了一个房间来惩罚性工作者，他喜欢在那里对基里进行淫荡和淫荡的惩罚。
通过基里的调查，他发现这起事件的幕后主使是他的前恋人——真冬。在成功将她带到自己家的地下室进行报复后，总司发誓要对那些因这次事件而成为他敌人的女学生做同样的事情。

总司的报复手段是通过快乐进行统治——为了实现这一目标，他决心将他的猎物变成放荡的囚犯。
